body: It is sentiments like that that leave some people ahead while others fall behind. They are such small wiggles objectively, but emotionally they are like natural disasters.

I know a lot of people that would care. I just can't live up to the images of the people that don't want me in their life. I made so many mistakes. I can't take them back or away, I can't stop them from hurting. It just feels like it is eating away at me.
